_doc: Guided training lessons as data (tool 6 of Lote 1, docs/ESPECIFICACION_HERRAMIENTAS_LOTE1.md §6). Hand-written; read by src/shared/training.ts (parseLessons), the web and the desktop port. Frame: the simulator's own, metres from the take-off point (n north, e east), alt = height over the ground, deg = heading clockwise from north (0 north, 90 east). Every step is checked ONLY against telemetry frames (not against the input used): takeoff { alt, tol = 0.5, withinS = 20 } armed, in flight and |alt - target| < tol (withinS: seconds before the hint appears); hold { seconds, tolH = 1, tolAlt = 0.5 } stays inside the sphere captured when the step starts for `seconds` (leaving resets the count); reach { n, e, alt, tol = 1.5 } within tol of the point (3D, inclusive); orbit { turns = 1, rMin, rMax } the unwrapped angle around the centre captured when the step starts reaches 2*pi*turns, in either direction, without leaving [rMin, rMax] (leaving resets it); yaw { deg, tol = 10 } absolute heading within tol; land { n, e, radius } landed and disarmed within radius of the point; course { courseId } delegates to the test course of tool 5 (contracts/courses/<courseId>.json, src/shared/course.ts). Step ids are unique and key the texts of design/training.json (title, objective, hint).
